criteria.criterion: Run bounded read-only discovery against several real sources
criteria.implementation: Fixed public endpoints and production read-only adapters. Remotive and RemoteOK each use one exact GET; Greenhouse uses two exact fixed GETs for board metadata and jobs?content=true. Each capture is bounded to 20 seconds, 6-second requests, at most 5 MB per response and at most 1000 jobs. Greenhouse also enforces concurrency 1 and one-second request-start spacing. Exact captured wire bytes are replayed offline through collect_source in isolated temporary SQLite workspaces.
criteria.test_oracle: The e696 Remotive and RemoteOK captures both completed two production collections and two reopens. The ca1 Greenhouse tenant greenhouse capture returned HTTP 200 for both fixed endpoints and likewise completed both collections/reopens. These three distinct production adapters satisfy several real sources. WWR remains separately failed: original probe precondition failure, then actual production SOURCE_DUPLICATE_JOB_ID.

criteria.implementation: verify_source calls the unchanged production collect_source with refresh_matches=False and no profile. Every raw captured job must be seen with rejected=0, and persisted source-copy counts are checked after each collection and database reopen.
criteria.test_oracle: Remotive: 13 canonical jobs, 13 source copies and 13 snapshots. RemoteOK: 99 canonical jobs, 99 source copies and 99 snapshots. Greenhouse: 19 canonical jobs, 19 source copies and 19 snapshots. criteria.criterion: Do not submit applications during this phase
criteria.implementation: Only fixed GET listing/careers transports are called. Discovery remains MANUAL_ONLY; offline collections use no applicant profile. Socket/subprocess egress is denied during replay, direct_application must be false and application/attempt tables must remain empty.
criteria.test_oracle: All three successful sources record zero external submission requests, zero application records/attempts and zero offline egress attempts. Remotive/RemoteOK use one fixed external GET each; Greenhouse uses exactly its two fixed GETs. Temporary databases are removed after successful checks. Reviewed scripts contain no submission or paid-provider call path.
